# Introduction

The {{"template":"referral","description":"a rechargeable energy item","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is a rechargeable energy item introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.1.0"}}. Its {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy"}} can be charged in any {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:power_bank"}}, and discharged in any {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine"}} that accepts {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy"}}.

# Stats

Information about a {{"of":"self"}} can be viewed by hovering over the item in an inventory.

The {{"of":"self"}} can hold up to 12,000 {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy","text":"TE"}}.

The maximum amount of {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy"}} that can be inserted or extracted in a single game tick is 512 {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy","text":"TE"}}.

# Usage

To charge a {{"of":"self"}}, place it in the extraction slot (arrow pointing up) of a {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:power_bank"}} containing energy.

Once charged, the {{"of":"self"}} can transfer power to {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine","plural":true}} or other {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:power_bank","plural":true}} in their insertion slots (arrow pointing down).

The battery tier does not need to match the tier of the {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine"}} it is powering.

# Upgrading

{{"of":"self","plural":true}} can be directly upgraded into a {{"of":"minecraft:item / to_sky_and_stars:steel_battery"}}, a {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/tier2","text":"tier 2 battery"}} with an increased storage capacity of TBD {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy","text":"TE"}}. The crafting recipe for this involves {{"of":"minecraft:item / to_sky_and_stars:steel_ingot","plural":true}}, requiring other machines of at least {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/tier1","text":"tier 1"}}.
